name: hwp-form
description: Fill Korean HWP/HWPX application forms from your saved profile and materials into a new HWPX copy, leaving signatures, consent, and gaps on a checklist.

interface.longDescription: Read an HWPX form, map each answer cell, fill profile facts and drafts from your material into a new HWPX copy with read-back verification, and list what is left for you: choices, signatures, consent, attachments. Never touches the original.
